전체 물의 양 = 2.0 리터


@양배추물김치 조리 과정@
1. 양배추, 적양배추는 먹기 좋은 크기로 손질한 뒤 헹궈 천일염 1.5큰술에 물 1컵을 넣고 40분 절이고,  2. 오이 2개는 4등분으로 자르고 씨를 제거한 뒤 천일염 반 큰술에 물 1컵을 넣고 40분 절인다.
3. 믹서에 사과, 양파 반개, 청양고추 1개, 생강 반 톨, 찹쌀 풀, 생수 2컵을 넣고 갈고 
4. 홍고추 1개는 채 썰고 쪽파 반 줌은 4~5cm로 자른다.
5. 갈아진 채소양념을 체 위에 올려놓고 생수 2리터 중 남은 것을 다 부어서 걸러내고 남은 건더기는 면포 등으로 남김없이 짜준다.
6. 김치통에 채소들을 다 넣고 국물을 붓는다.

* 레시피를 문의하시는 분이 계셔서 제가 댓글에 남깁니다 ^^

* 이 레시피는 건더기를 매우 많게 해서 채소들의 영양분을 섭취하기 위함이었습니다.

KimchiTeacher LeeHaYeon's CheonsuMuPpaGaeJi recipe! ❤If you're curious about the recipe, check out KimchiTeacher LeeHaYeon!❤

Ingredients: 5kg CheonsuMu, 150g sea salt
Seasoning: 150g red pepper powder, 30g fine red pepper powder, 100g minced garlic, 30g minced ginger, 100g green onions, 200g glutinous rice porridge, 100g anchovy sauce, 80g salted shrimp, 300g pear, 5g black sesame seeds

Directions:
1. Trim the base of the CheonsuMu, leaving only the tender leaves, and wash thoroughly. Slice the radish in half and marinate in salt for 2 hours. Then, make 3-4 cuts and marinate for an additional hour. 2. Marinate for about 3 hours, then drain in a colander.
3. Cut the pear into large pieces and trim the green onions into 4-5cm pieces.
4. Place the pickled radish in a bowl, add the red pepper powder, and mix to combine.
5. Mix the remaining seasonings to create a seasoning sauce. Add the radish with the red pepper mixture and mix well. Finish by adding the trimmed pear and green onions.
6. Place in a kimchi container, cover with cabbage leaves or pickled radish leaves, and store in a cool place for a day or two before refrigerating.

snippet.description:
#청양고추열무물김치 #열무포기김치 #열무김치  #요리 #김치쌤 #이하연
김치쌤 이하연의 청양고추열무물김치 만들기!  ❤레시피가 궁금하다면, 김치쌤 이하연에서 확인하세요!❤

재료: 어린열무 2kg, 물 500ml, 토판염 50g, 쪽파 30g, 홍고추 2개, 감자풀(감자 120g, 밀가루 20g, 물 500ml)
양념: 배 300g, 청양고추 200g, 마늘 60g, 생강 10g, 건고추 30g, 물 2L, 토판염 35g

조리법:
1. 어린열무 뿌리를 제거해 3회 씻고 소금물에 30분간 절인다.
2. 씻은 열무를 채반에 받쳐 물기를 뺀다.
3. 마른고추는 꼭지를 떼고 물에 씻어 3~4등분하고, 다시마물과 마늘, 생강, 밀가루풀을 넣고 믹서기에 갈아 양념장을 만든다.
4. 양념장에 멸치생젓, 멸치액젓과 멸치가루, 고춧가루를 넣고 김치 국물을 만든다. 
5. 열무와 준비된 고명을 김치 국물에 묻히듯이 살살 섞어 버무린다. 한 끼 분량씩 타래를 지어 통에 차곡차곡 담는다.
6. 상온에서 하루 익혀 냉장고에 넣고, 열흘이 지나면 먹는다. (더울 때는 상온에 10시간 정도 숙성한 후 냉장고에 보관하고, 새콤한 맛이 들면 먹는다.)

en-US.title: Spicy, crunchy, and refreshing! Cheongyang pepper and radish water kimchi
en-US.description:
#CheongyangPepperYeolmuMulKimchi #YeolmuBagKimchi #YeolmuKimchi #Cooking #KimchiTeacher #LeeHayeon
KimchiTeacher LeeHayeon's CheongyangPepperYeolmuMulKimchi! ❤If you're curious about the recipe, check out KimchiTeacher LeeHayeon!❤

Ingredients: 2kg young radish, 500ml water, 50g salt, 30g green onion, 2 red peppers, potato starch (120g potato, 20g flour, 500ml water)
Seasoning: 300g pear, 200g Cheongyang pepper, 60g garlic, 10g ginger, 30g dried red pepper, 2L water, 35g salt

Directions:
1. Remove the roots of the young radish, wash them three times, and soak them in salt water for 30 minutes.
2. Drain the washed radish in a colander. 3. Remove the stems from the dried chili peppers, wash them in water, and cut them into 3-4 pieces. Blend them in a blender with kelp water, garlic, ginger, and flour paste to make a seasoning sauce.
4. Add anchovy sauce, anchovy sauce, anchovy powder, and red pepper powder to the seasoning sauce to make a kimchi broth.
5. Gently mix the young radish and prepared toppings, coating them in the kimchi broth. Form individual servings and place them neatly in a container.
6. Let them ripen at room temperature for a day, then store in the refrigerator. Enjoy after 10 days. (In hot weather, let them ripen at room temperature for about 10 hours, then store in the refrigerator. Enjoy when they develop a sour flavor.)

미역냉국

조리법:
1. 마른 미역을 찬물에 20분 정도 불려준다.
2. 두 번 정도 헹군 다음 물기를 꾹 짜서 먹기 좋은 길이로 잘라준다.

4. 미역과 오이에 국간장, 설탕, 사과식초, 다진 마늘을 넣고 조물조물 버무려 간이 배게 한다.
5. 청홍고추를 썰어넣고 생수 4컵을 부어 간을 맞춘 다음 통깨, 얼음을 넣어 먹는다.

조리법:
1. 불린 미역을 먹기 좋은 길이로 썰고 물기를 제거한다.
2. 오이는 채칼로 씨부분을 제외하고 썰어준다.
3. 오이는 채칼로 씨 부분을 제거하고 채썰어 놓는다.
4. 미역과 오이채에 청홍고추를 채썰어 넣은 다음 다진 마늘, 간장, 식초, 설탕을 넣고 버무린다. 통깨를 뿌려 먹는다.

en-US.title: Cabbage Water Kimchi A super refreshing recipe that even beginners can't fail
en-US.description:
@Cabbage Water Kimchi@ 
*Basic Ingredients 
Half a head of cabbage 
1/4 head of red cabbage (optional) 
2 cucumbers 
Half an apple 
Half an onion 
2 Cheongyang peppers 
6 cloves garlic 
Half a head of ginger 
2 tablespoons anchovy sauce 
1 red pepper 
1/3 handful of green onions 
50 mL plum extract 
Glutinous rice paste (1 heaping tablespoon of glutinous rice flour + 2 cups of water) 
Total amount of water = 2.0 liters

@Cabbage Water Kimchi Recipe@ 
1. Trim the cabbage and red cabbage into bite-sized pieces, rinse, and marinate in 1.5 tablespoons of sea salt and 1 cup of water for 40 minutes. 2. Cut 2 cucumbers into quarters, remove the seeds, and season with half a sea salt. Add 1 cup of water to a tablespoon of kimchi and marinate for 40 minutes.
3. Blend together an apple, half an onion, 1 green chili pepper, 1/2 a piece of ginger, glutinous rice paste, and 2 cups of water in a blender.

4. Slice 1 red chili pepper and cut 1/2 a handful of green onions into 4-5cm pieces.

5. Place the ground vegetable seasoning in a sieve and pour in the remaining 2 liters of water to strain. Squeeze out any remaining solids with a cheesecloth.

6. Place all the vegetables in a kimchi container and pour in the broth.

* I've received a request for the recipe, so I'm leaving this in the comments. ^^

* This recipe uses a lot of solids to maximize the nutrients from the vegetables.

You can also use half the cabbage.

7. 분량의 양념 재료를 잘 섞고 부재료를 모두 넣어 버무린다. 배춧잎 사이에 소를 넣은 후 겉잎으로 전체를 돌려 싸고 단면이 위로 오도록 통에 담는다.

en-US.title: Fresh as ever! Abalone kimchi generously filled with fresh abalone!
en-US.description:
#AbaloneKimchi #Cooking #KimchiTeacher #LeeHayeon
LeeHayeon Kimchi: Making Abalone Kimchi! ❤If you're curious about the abalone kimchi recipe, check out LeeHayeon Kimchi!❤

Ingredients: 3 heads of cabbage, 750g salt, 3L water, 10 abalones, 1kg radish, 500g pear, 150g mustard greens, 150g green onions, 150g water parsley, a pinch of shredded red pepper, a pinch of black sesame seeds
Broth: 20g kelp, 1L water
Seasoning: 1/2 cup shrimp sauce, 1 cup fermented yellow corvina, 1/2 cup anchovy sauce, 400g red pepper powder, 300g minced garlic, 50g minced ginger, 3 cups kelp stock, 2 cups glutinous rice porridge

Directions:
1. Cut the base of the cabbage and split it open by hand. Dissolve half the salt in water, then pour the salt water between the cabbage leaves to moisten them. Sprinkle the remaining salt evenly over the cabbage stems. Prepare a large container and stack the salted cabbage leaves with the insides facing up. Pour the remaining salt water over them. After 5 hours, switch the cabbages, flip them over, and marinate for another 5 hours. Rinse the marinated cabbage three times under running water to remove any salt. Drain the water by turning it over in a colander.
2. Boil 300g of kelp in 1L of water for 1 hour, remove the kelp, and let it cool. Use the broth.
3. Soak 1 cup of glutinous rice. Boil 1 cup of soaked glutinous rice with 7 cups of water, then let it cool.
4. Slice the radish and pear into 2mm thick strips.
5. Slice the mustard greens, chives, and water parsley into 4cm lengths. 6. Clean and wash the abalone, then slice it thinly.
7. Mix the seasoning ingredients well and add all the other ingredients. Place the filling between the cabbage leaves, wrap the entire thing with the outer leaves, and place it in a container with the cut side facing up.
8. Fill the container about 4/5 full with kimchi, cover with the green outer leaves, and press down firmly to prevent air from entering.
